ai-model-s-no-longer-exist.text: 2 AI model(s) NO LONGER EXIST at the provider -- content generation will 404: `nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free (social-agent/config.js -> OpenRouter (nemotron)); nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free (newsletter-agent/config.js -> OpenRouter (nemotron))`. List what is actually served with `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $GROQ_API_KEY" https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/models` or `curl https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models`, then repoint the config.
